links.comparator_used: Single-radiologist review of LLM-generated patient answers (versus dual- and triple-reader review); no unreviewed-release arm was tested
links.outcome: Miss rate of deficient LLM-generated patient answers (clinically significant errors and incomplete/ambiguous responses) under radiologist review
links.effect: Single reader missed an average of 12.4% of deficiencies; dual-reader review reduced the average miss rate to 0.6%; triple-reader review detected all deficiencies. Individual reader sensitivity ranged from 81.4% to 96.5%, and readers missed 5.6-11.1% of clinically significant errors.
